title: Unpublished Moments of the Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, at the Home of the Late Allameh Mesbah Yazdi.
text:
Unpublished Moments of the Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, at the Home of the Late Allameh Mesbah Yazdi."

"➕ A report on the holding of the Velayat Project courses by the late Allameh Mesbah Yazdi for the Supreme Leader, His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, and the children of the martyred Leader of the Revolution."

"🔺 In this meeting, which took place at the home of the late Allameh Mesbah Yazdi on September 30, 2016, Mohammadi Golpayegani, head of the office of the martyred Leader of the Revolution, and the children of the martyred Leader of the Revolution were present.
